notes.title: Update 0.6.7.5 - Updated Map, other features and fixes
notes.content:
Cheers, mates!

We are happy to announce new features and fixes.
Starting from end of MAY updates are going to be released every month, but they are going to be bigger. We are going to start moving towards our [b]roadmap [/b]with [b]major updates[/b]. 

Don't forget to share your feedback in discord.

[b]New Features[/b]
- Map Updated: New image
- New game menu screen: New image

[b]Adjustments[/b]
- Terrain fixes around the Power Plant
- Mini map now is 2x zoomed out

[b]Fixes[/b]
- Continue button on Pause screen
- Ship sounds were working on the loading screen
- Terrain in Paris

Thank you for your support through this journey of the game development process.

If you have feedback about the game or want to report bugs feel free to contact us via discord channel - [u]https://discord.gg/CSuqGs65Ad[/u]

notes.content:

Starting from middle of MAY updates are going to be released every month, but they are going to be bigger. We are going to start moving towards our [b]roadmap [/b]with [b]major updates[/b].

- New UV maps and textures for submarine model
- New Music 3: Vilnius, Athens, Radioactive zone tracks

Thank you for your support through this journey of the game development process.

If you have feedback about the game or want to report bugs feel free to contact us via discord channel - [u]https://discord.gg/CSuqGs65Ad[/u]

notes.title: Update 0.6.6 - New Quests, Features and Fixes
notes.content:
Cheers, mates!

We are happy to announce new Quests, features and a few fixes are being implemented in update 0.6.6.
Starting from April updates is going to be released every two weeks, but they are going to be bigger.

[b]New Features[/b]
- New Quests: 3 new quests added to the game
- Loading progress bar
- New sounds: Ambience, fish swim, Kraken spit impact
- Now game saves last known mini map position after using the map
- Added Gates to the Pirate city: you can destroy it with only the upgraded weaponry 

[b]Adjustments[/b]
- Fish speed increased: swim and turn around
- Paris Initiative 1 and 2 levels: You get the automatically after completing quests
- Fish health increased
- Quest updated: minor spelling mistakes, requirements and description 
- Geyser no longer gives 8 gas: now it is from 2 to 4

[b]Fixes[/b]
- Faster game levels loading times
- Submarine sound stuck on loop after opening the menu

Thank you for your support through this journey of the game development process.

If you have feedback about the game or want to report bugs feel free to contact us via discord channel - https://discord.gg/CSuqGs65Ad

notes.title: Update 0.6.5 - New features and Fixes
notes.content:
Cheers, mates!

We are happy to announce new features and a few fixes.
Starting from April updates is going to be released every two weeks, but they are going to be bigger.

[b]New Features[/b]
- Stackable resources: Now you can stack up to 4 resources in one storage slot
- New gas and metal resource icons
- Pirate boss: added dash (left and right)
- Confirmation for resource drop added
- City titles added
- Upgrades tutorial border added

[b]Adjustments[/b]
- Kraken boss intro view
- Kraken boss zone: new colliders added
- Pirate boss zone: rearrangement of terrain
- More gas resources in Paris and Athens zones added 
- Increase of resource requirements for Upgrades and Quests: 100% increase

[b]Fixes[/b]
- Pirate boss teleport after entering the cave fixed
- Terrain fixes in the Athens zone

Thank you for your support through this journey of the game development process.

If you have feedback about the game or want to report bugs feel free to contact us via discord channel - https://discord.gg/CSuqGs65Ad

notes.title: New Update 0.6.2.1
notes.content:
Hello, Captains,

We are happy to announce new features and a few fixes.

[b]New Features[/b]
- Objectives tab: Now you can track your quests and have hints where to go next
- Auto save: Every 10 seconds your gameplay autosaves

[b]Adjustments[/b]
- Pirates speed and attack range: Pirates now a bit more aggressive and have 2x faster speed
- Submarine reverse speed: Now it is a bit slower to swim backwards
- Pirate boss cave: got a new better look
- Scurvy Dogs quest description: has a better hints what to do next
- Pirate ships got names: Cannoneer and Rocketeer
- More enemies spawn points

[b]Fixes[/b]
- No sound bug: Fixed
- Terrain fixes between Paris and Pirate city
- Grass and terrain that caused lag in northern part of Paris
- Terrain fix in Athens territory near the Pirate boss cave

If you have feedback about the game or want to report bugs feel free to contact us via discord channel - https://discord.gg/CSuqGs65Ad

notes.title: First Update
notes.content:
Hello, Captains,

We are releasing our first patch, which includes:
- Crew member messages
- Enemies don't go through terrain anymore (bug fixed)
- More resources spawn points
- More enemies spawn points
- Map fix
- Terrain fixes
- Pirate boss cave lights
- Resource bugs fixed
- Added more sounds
- Other smaller things

For March we are planning on doing regular patches weekly. After that we will swift to bigger content patches which prioritize content of the game.

If you have feedback about the game or want to report bugs feel free to contact us via discord channel - https://discord.gg/CSuqGs65Ad
